description.en: Rings the user's iPhone through the /call-me app when a run needs an answer: the agent's question is read aloud and the spoken reply goes back into the run as text. The iPhone app is a paid subscription.
description.zh: 当运行需要回答时，通过 /call-me 应用给用户的 iPhone 打电话：Agent 的提问被朗读出来，口头回答以文字形式回到运行中。该 iPhone 应用为付费订阅。
